---
title: "Figure 4A - Six-month antibody profiles by vaccination timing"
output: html_document
---

This notebook displays percentile-ranked six-month antibody profiles for the
three maternal vaccination-timing groups. Run `01_load_data.Rmd` first.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)

helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "analysis_functions.R"))

stopifnot(all(vapply(c("temp_data", "temp_meta"), exists, logical(1))))
```

## 1. Rank measurements within each feature

```{r prepare-data}
antigen_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    "RBD_beta", "RBD_delta", "RBD_gamma", "RBD_omicron", "S1", "S2",
    "Spike_alpha", "Spike_beta", "Spike_delta", "Spike_gamma",
    "Spike_omicron", "RBD_alpha", "RBD_WT", "Spike_WT", "OC43", "HKU1"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)
serology_data <- select_serology_features(
  temp_data,
  include = antigen_pattern,
  exclude = "$^"
)

polar_data <- serology_data %>%
  mutate(vaccine_group = temp_meta$Vax_group) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(names(serology_data)),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(percentile_rank = percent_rank(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(vaccine_group, feature) %>%
  summarize(mean_percentile = mean(percentile_rank, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  separate(
    feature,
    into = c("assay", "antigen"),
    sep = "_",
    extra = "merge",
    remove = FALSE
  )
```

## 2. Select the Figure 4A antigens and assays

```{r select-features}
antigen_levels <- c("Spike WT", "S1", "S2", "RBD WT")
excluded_assays <- c("IgM", "IgA1", "IgA2", "IgG2", "IgG4", "FcaR")

polar_summary <- polar_data %>%
  mutate(
    antigen = gsub("_", " ", antigen),
    antigen = factor(antigen, levels = antigen_levels),
    assay = recode(
      assay,
      IgG = "Total\nIgG",
      FcgR2AR = "FcgR2A",
      FcgR3AV = "FcgR3A"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(antigen), !assay %in% excluded_assays)
```

## 3. Plot the three timing groups

```{r plot-profiles}
antigen_colors <- viridis(length(antigen_levels))
names(antigen_colors) <- antigen_levels

plot_polar_group <- function(group_name) {
  plot_data <- polar_summary[polar_summary$vaccine_group == group_name, ]

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(assay, mean_percentile, fill = antigen)) +
    geom_col(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.25,
      position = position_dodge()
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    coord_polar(clip = "off") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = antigen_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = group_name, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Antigen") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16)
    )
}

group_levels <- c("<20 weeks", "20 - 28 weeks", ">28 weeks")
polar_plots <- lapply(group_levels, plot_polar_group)
figure_4a <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = polar_plots,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right",
  nrow = 1,
  ncol = 3
)
```

## 4. Save Figure 4A

```{r save-figure}
ggsave(
  output_path("Figure_4", "Figure_4A_polar_profiles.png"),
  figure_4a,
  width = 14,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)
```
